messages:
Alejandra: heads up — we need a small compatibility note + example for the new invokeEnvelope vs. old tool_call envelope. Customer reported parser errors when their SDK uses the compact envelope.
jamie: can you paste the minimal failing response?
Alejandra: pasted below from the bug report:
```json
{
  "invokeEnvelope": {
    "tool": "search",
    "args": {
      "q": "redwood inference docs"
    }
  }
}
```
jamie: ah — their SDK still parses for `tool_call` top-level key. We should add a short migration note and a tiny shim example for python-js. I can do python snippet.
marco: I can handle the TypeScript/SDK example and the docs link anchors. Which page to update?
Alejandra: update /docs/guides/structured-output.md and add a small section "Interop shim for older callers". Also add anchor so partners can link directly.
tasha: quick lint check: remember to run the link-checker action locally. docs-bot: Link-checker found 2 broken links in PR 4721 (docs/guides/structured-output.md).
marco: re: anchors — avoid changing existing headings. I'll append an H3 `Interop shim (legacy callers)` so existing links don't break.
jamie: python shim suggestion:
```py
# legacy_adapter.py
def normalize_envelope(resp):
    # support both old `tool_call` and new `invokeEnvelope` shapes
    if 'invokeEnvelope' in resp:
        return resp['invokeEnvelope']
    if 'tool_call' in resp:
        return resp['tool_call']
    return resp
```
jamie: will open PR against `docs-site` with the snippet and a one-liner migration paragraph.
Alejandra: great. Also add a note about parsers that expect `arguments` to be a JSON string vs object — add a tiny example and a warning to avoid double-encoding.
marco: started a draft PR 4721 with TS snippet, anchor, and link fixes. pushing now.
tasha: I'll do the final pass once both snippets are in. Quick checklist: run `yarn docs:build`, run link-checker, confirm code fencing shows language labels.
Alejandra: small editorial: use "compact envelope" consistently across page, not mixed terms. Also add regression test: sample prompt + expected normalized JSON.
jamie: added a one-line unit test in the PR description to show expected behavior.
docs-bot: PR 4721 opened by marco — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4721 (status: draft).
marco: pinging eng-ml for review on the parsing guidance? @eng-ml might want to confirm we don't recommend wide parsing heuristics.
Alejandra: yes, don't recommend regex extraction. Recommend strict schema + small tolerant adapter like above.
marco: OK — I'm going to merge the TS snippet updates to the draft, will tag you all for review.
Tasha: typo in the migration blurb: "invokEnvelope" -> "invokeEnvelope" (will fix in my pass).
Alejandra: thanks — leaving a short acceptance checklist in the PR: 1) both snippets in, 2) link-check green, 3) CI static check green, 4) eng-ml ack. I'll close the thread when merged. :white_check_mark:
